memory.phase_semantics: Peaks end at the current boundary after the preceding reset. checkpoint_begin records the preceding validation/boundary window; only checkpoint_complete after checkpoint_begin is checkpoint writing. Loading excludes earlier source verification and process startup.

native_counters.no_skips_evidence: Explicit per-update applied outcomes, zero rejection counters and matching optimizer/attempt clocks; checkpoint controls audited separately.
native_counters.preprocessing_counter_scope: Cumulative counters can include initial/in-loop validation. Processing and waiting overlap execution; never sum them into wall time.

cost_scope: Each native command includes process startup, source/model preparation, 20 updates, initial/final validation, checkpoint writing and shutdown. Own checkpoint inspection is additional. This screen does not include fresh-process task scoring, portable export or recovery, and is not inclusive time-to-quality.
limits: One fixed-order cell per configuration; no paired repeated uncertainty or execution winner.
No other campaign media job overlapped. Filesystem/page-cache state and other tenants were not controlled.
No NF4 speed advantage is demonstrated. NF4 without checkpointing has a retained 48.18-second update-three anomaly; attribution requires more evidence.
All 20 compared numerical update metrics match full/no-checkpointing within each precision. This is not a tensor/optimizer/RNG/data or reload/resume equivalence proof.
The BF16/full native stage has one incomplete host-memory sample; its host completeness remains false. All four GPU-process observations are valid sampled lower bounds, not true peaks.
The 24 GiB follow-up screen is not physical hardware qualification and does not constrain the strong BF16 baseline on the actual 80 GB accelerator.
Configured context/video limits do not establish larger actual processed shapes. These runs use the existing short WTS workload.
The 64 validation rows belong to one exposed recording group and cannot select task quality or establish independent-group uncertainty.
The actual three host fixtures qualify the historical v4 reader on this allocation; the later v5 retry needs its own target check and cannot repair this failed historical sample.
